title: WarpMap model: markers, beat numbering, warp mode, transpose and detune
description:
## Intent
The model both directions share: `apricity_daw::warp::WarpMap` and how it is built from a sample.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-daw/src/warp.rs`: `WarpMap { markers: Vec<(seconds, beat)>, warped: bool, mode: DawWarpMode, transpose: i32, detune_cents: i32, region: Option<(start_s, end_s)>, loop_on: bool }`.
- `WarpMap::from_clip(&apricity_score::Clip)`: markers from `rhythm.warp_markers` (M4 later switches this to the effective grid); `warped = has_beats()`; detune = rounded `-tuning_cents`, split into transpose + detune when beyond the DAW's range (per §Formats); mode per §Mapping (drum stems `beats`, everything else `complex`).
- Beat numbering exactly as `design/daw-sidecars.md` §Formats decided (negative pickups kept, or a recorded offset).
- `DawWarpMode` covers all six DAW modes; conversions to/from `apricity_score::score::WarpModeSpec` are partial and say so.
- Unit tests for detune splitting (-30, -70, +55 cents) and mode mapping.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw warp`.

Commit: `feat(<this id>): warp map model for DAW sidecars`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
